steps.text: Login to the mobile application, Land on Loans dashboard

Loan details will be clicked by default to display following details: 
 a. Contract type / number
 b. Currency
 c. Next payment date / amount
 d. Interest rate
 e. Outstanding amount
 f. Maturity date
 g. Late payment charge 
 h. Loan  tenor 
 i. Disbursement date
 j. Contract amount
